title: Mountain Dining Plans: Arrears Period and Reinstatement Fee
content:
Two figures on the accounts side attach to every plan in the Mountain Dining Plans range: the number of calendar days a plan fee may stand unpaid before spending is stopped, and the fee for starting spending again after it was stopped for arrears.

| Plan | Calendar days a plan fee may stand unpaid | Fee to start spending again |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Mountain Bites Dining Card | 14 | $15.00 |
| Peak Plate Dining Plan | 14 | $15.00 |
| Summit Table Dining Plan | 21 | $25.00 |
| Alpine Club Dining Membership | 30 | $0.00 |
| Chef's Table Dining Membership | 30 | $0.00 |
| Collective Hospitality Dining Membership | 45 | $0.00 |

The two figures do not move together across the range. The arrears period never shortens across the range, standing at 14 calendar days on the two plans at the foot, 21 on the Summit Table Dining Plan, 30 on the two memberships above it and 45 at the head, while the reinstatement fee rises once, from $15.00 to $25.00 on the Summit Table Dining Plan, and then falls to $0.00 on the three memberships above it, which carry no such fee at all.
